_about: Venue logistics for L.I.S.A. Routes use the standard public-transport options for each venue; times and fares are approximate (checked 2026-10) and every answer tells fans to re-check on the day.

venues.name: KSPO DOME (Olympic Park)

steps: AREX all-stop train to Gimpo Airport Station (~35 min)
Transfer to Line 9 express toward VHS Medical Center
Get off at Olympic Park Station, Exit 3, walk ~5 min
Airport limousine bus to the Jamsil / Lotte World stop (~80 min)
Taxi ~10 min to Olympic Park
Line 9 express (or Line 5 toward Hanam) from Gimpo Airport
Olympic Park Station, Exit 3
Line 4 to Dongdaemun History & Culture Park
Transfer to Line 5 toward Hanam / Macheon
Olympic Park Station, Exit 3

lockers: Station lockers inside Olympic Park Station fill by early afternoon on show days
Backup: lockers at Jamsil Station (Line 2 / Line 8), one stop away by taxi
Many fans pre-book a luggage-storage app spot near Jamsil
tips: After the show, Olympic Park Station is packed for ~40 min; walk 10 min to Mongchontoseong (Line 8) instead
Goods (MD) lines usually start the morning of each show day

venues.name: The Colosseum at Caesars Palace
venues.address: 3570 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV
nearest_stations: Inside Caesars Palace on the Las Vegas Strip
Las Vegas Monorail: Flamingo/Caesars Palace station (~10 min walk)

steps: Taxi or rideshare from the Terminal 1 or Terminal 3 pickup zone
Drop-off at Caesars Palace main entrance; follow signs to The Colosseum
RTC route 108 / Deuce connection toward the Strip
Walk to Caesars Palace

lockers: Caesars Palace bell desk holds bags for hotel guests
Non-guests: use a luggage-storage app on the Strip; large bags are not allowed inside the venue
tips: Shows start in the evening; rideshare surge pricing is common right after the show
Check The Colosseum's bag policy before you go

venues.name: Kaohsiung National Stadium (World Games Main Stadium)
nearest_stations: Kaohsiung MRT Red Line R17 World Games station, Exit 2

steps: Kaohsiung MRT Red Line from R4 Kaohsiung International Airport toward Gangshan
Get off at R17 World Games, Exit 2, walk ~5 min
Taoyuan Airport MRT to HSR Taoyuan Station
Taiwan High Speed Rail to Zuoying (~1 h 40 min)
Kaohsiung MRT Red Line one stop to R17 World Games
Kaohsiung MRT Red Line one stop north to R17 World Games

lockers: Coin lockers at HSR / MRT Zuoying Station
Stadium area has no public lockers - travel light
tips: Open-air stadium: bring a rain poncho; umbrellas are usually not allowed in the stands
Extra MRT trains run after the show but queues are long

venues.name: Rajamangala National Stadium
venues.address: Ramkhamhaeng Road, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok
nearest_stations: Airport Rail Link: Ramkhamhaeng station (then ~10 min taxi)
MRT Yellow Line: Lam Sali / Hua Mak area (then taxi)

steps: Airport Rail Link city line toward Phaya Thai
Get off at Ramkhamhaeng station (~20 min)
Taxi or motorbike taxi ~10 min to the stadium
Public taxi from the arrivals taxi queue (expressway)

lockers: Left-luggage counters in Suvarnabhumi arrivals hall
No public lockers at the stadium
tips: Roads around Ramkhamhaeng jam from mid-afternoon on show days - arrive early
Book a ride back in advance or walk to the Airport Rail Link

venues.name: National Stadium, Singapore Sports Hub

steps: MRT from Changi Airport to Tanah Merah
Change to the East-West Line toward Tuas Link, get off at Paya Lebar
Circle Line toward Dhoby Ghaut / HarbourFront, get off at Stadium (CC6)
Taxi or Grab from the arrivals taxi stand via the ECP

lockers: Baggage storage counters at Changi Airport
Large bags are not allowed in the stadium
tips: Kallang MRT is a calmer alternative to Stadium MRT after the show
Retractable roof - weather is rarely an issue
